AbandonedBaby: The Abandoned Baby is a three-candle reversal pattern where a doji gaps away from a long candle and the third candle gaps back.
AdvanceBlock: The Advance Block is a three-candle bearish pattern of rising white candles whose bodies shrink or whose upper shadows grow, which signals a weakening uptrend.
BeltHold: The Belt Hold is a single long candle that opens at one extreme of its range and closes near the other.
Breakaway: The Breakaway is a five-candle reversal pattern where a gap starts a three-candle run and the fifth candle closes inside the gap.
ClosingMarubozu: The Closing Marubozu is a long candle with no or a very short shadow on its closing end.
ConcealedBabySwallow: The Concealed Baby Swallow is a four-candle bullish pattern of black candles where the fourth candle engulfs the third, including its shadows.
Counterattack: The Counterattack is a two-candle reversal pattern where a long candle follows a long candle of the opposite color and closes at the same price.
DarkCloudCover: The Dark Cloud Cover is a two-candle bearish pattern where a black candle opens above the prior white high and closes deep into its body.
Doji: The Doji is a single candle where the open and close are almost equal, which shows indecision between buyers and sellers.
DojiStar: The Doji Star is a two-candle pattern where a doji gaps away from a long candle in the direction of the trend.
DragonflyDoji: The Dragonfly Doji is a doji that opens and closes at the high of the period and has a long lower shadow.
Engulfing: The Engulfing is a two-candle reversal pattern where the second candle's body fully covers the prior candle's body and has the opposite color.
EveningDojiStar: The Evening Doji Star is a three-candle bearish pattern where a doji gaps up from a long white candle and a black candle follows.
EveningStar: The Evening Star is a three-candle bearish pattern where a short body gaps up from a long white candle and a black candle follows.
GapSideBySideWhite: The Gap Side-by-Side White is a three-candle continuation pattern where two similar white candles with about the same open follow a gap.
GravestoneDoji: The Gravestone Doji is a doji that opens and closes at the low of the period and has a long upper shadow.
Hammer: The Hammer is a single bullish candle with a small body near the prior low, a long lower shadow, and little upper shadow.
HangingMan: The Hanging Man is a single bearish candle with a small body near the prior high, a long lower shadow, and little upper shadow.
Harami: The Harami is a two-candle reversal pattern where a short body sits fully inside the prior long body.
HaramiCross: The Harami Cross is a two-candle reversal pattern where a doji sits fully inside the prior long body.
HighWaveCandle: The High-Wave Candle is a single candle with a short body and very long upper and lower shadows, which shows indecision.
Hikkake: The Hikkake is a three-candle pattern where a false breakout follows an inside bar, which signals a move in the opposite direction.
HikkakeModified: The Modified Hikkake is a four-candle Hikkake where the second candle closes near the end of its range that opposes the breakout.
HomingPigeon: The Homing Pigeon is a two-candle bullish pattern where a short black body sits fully inside the prior long black body.
IdenticalThreeCrows: The Identical Three Crows is a three-candle bearish pattern of declining black candles where each candle opens at the prior candle's close.
InNeck: The In-Neck is a two-candle bearish pattern where a white candle opens below the prior black candle's low and closes slightly into its body.
InvertedHammer: The Inverted Hammer is a single bullish candle that gaps down and has a small body, a long upper shadow, and little lower shadow.
Kicking: The Kicking is a two-candle reversal pattern where a marubozu gaps away from a marubozu of the opposite color.
KickingByLength: The Kicking by Length is a Kicking pattern where the longer of the two marubozu candles sets the direction.
LadderBottom: The Ladder Bottom is a five-candle bullish pattern of four declining black candles followed by a white candle that closes above the prior candle's high.
LongLeggedDoji: The Long-Legged Doji is a doji with one or two long shadows, which shows indecision.
LongLineCandle: The Long Line Candle is a single candle with a long body and short shadows.
Marubozu: The Marubozu is a single candle with a long body and no or very short shadows.
MatHold: The Mat Hold is a five-candle bullish continuation pattern where three small candles hold within a long white body before the rise resumes.
MatchingLow: The Matching Low is a two-candle bullish pattern of two black candles that close at the same price.
MorningDojiStar: The Morning Doji Star is a three-candle bullish pattern where a doji gaps down from a long black candle and a white candle follows.
MorningStar: The Morning Star is a three-candle bullish pattern where a short body gaps down from a long black candle and a white candle follows.
OnNeck: The On-Neck is a two-candle bearish pattern where a white candle opens below the prior black candle's low and closes at that low.
Piercing: The Piercing is a two-candle bullish pattern where a white candle opens below the prior black low and closes above its body's middle.
RickshawMan: The Rickshaw Man is a doji with two long shadows and a body near the middle of the high-low range.
RiseFallThreeMethods: The Rising and Falling Three Methods is a five-candle continuation pattern where small counter-trend candles sit between two long trend candles.
SeparatingLines: The Separating Lines is a two-candle continuation pattern where a belt hold opens at the prior candle's open and has the opposite color.
ShootingStar: The Shooting Star is a single bearish candle that gaps up and has a small body, a long upper shadow, and little lower shadow.
ShortLineCandle: The Short Line Candle is a single candle with a short body and short shadows.
SpinningTop: The Spinning Top is a single candle with a small body and shadows longer than the body, which shows indecision.
StalledPattern: The Stalled Pattern is a three-candle bearish pattern of rising white candles where the third candle is small, which signals a stalling uptrend.
StickSandwich: The Stick Sandwich is a three-candle bullish pattern where a white candle sits between two black candles that close at the same price.
Takuri: The Takuri is a dragonfly doji with a very long lower shadow.
TasukiGap: The Tasuki Gap is a three-candle continuation pattern where, after a gap, a candle of the opposite color closes inside the gap without filling it.
ThreeBlackCrows: The Three Black Crows is a three-candle bearish pattern of declining black candles that each open within the prior body and close near their lows.
ThreeInside: The Three Inside is a three-candle reversal pattern where a third candle confirms a harami by closing beyond the first candle's open.
ThreeLineStrike: The Three-Line Strike is a four-candle pattern of three candles in the trend direction followed by a candle that reverses the whole move.
ThreeOutside: The Three Outside is a three-candle reversal pattern where a third candle confirms an engulfing pattern by closing beyond the second candle.
ThreeStarsInSouth: The Three Stars in the South is a three-candle bullish pattern of shrinking black candles whose lows stay inside the prior candle's range.
ThreeWhiteSoldiers: The Three White Soldiers is a three-candle bullish pattern of rising white candles that each open within the prior body and close near their highs.
Thrusting: The Thrusting is a two-candle bearish pattern where a white candle opens below the prior black low and closes below its body's middle.
Tristar: The Tristar is a three-candle reversal pattern of three doji where the middle doji gaps away from the other two.
TwoCrows: The Two Crows is a three-candle bearish pattern where two black candles follow a long white candle and the third closes inside the white body.
UniqueThreeRiver: The Unique Three River is a three-candle bullish pattern of a long black candle, a lower black harami, and a small white candle.
UpDownGapThreeMethods: The Upside and Downside Gap Three Methods is a three-candle continuation pattern where an opposite-color candle closes the gap between two candles.
UpsideGapTwoCrows: The Upside Gap Two Crows is a three-candle bearish pattern where two black candles gap above a white candle and the second engulfs the first.
